subject: a pear with a looped stem
art_direction: 深蓝梨形线条在顶部拐成小环，杏色一面像柔光照着脸。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Use one deep-blue line to form a pear whose stem curls into a small open loop. Tilt the body right and add an apricot half-plane that suggests soft light without gradients. Two tiny eye marks and a short off-center mouth convey subtle good humor. Keep the drawing airy and flat on warm cream with a clean unframed silhouette. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
